verdict.rationale: Raygun states it automatically captures diagnostics for every error occurrence. The pack points to all three platform tiers: JavaScript/browser source-map decoding for frontend, .NET SendInBackground and open-source .NET providers for backend, and dSYM and ProGuard mapping uploads for iOS and Android. However, no evidence item explicitly documents a list of official SDKs or how each one hooks uncaught exceptions. Missing for 10: an explicit official SDK catalogue across web, backend and mobile; documentation of automatic uncaught-exception handlers per SDK; independent hands-on corroboration of mobile and frontend auto-capture.

support.subject: As a developer, I can instrument my web frontend, backend services, and mobile apps with official SDKs that capture uncaught errors automatically

citations.quote: Raygun automatically captures detailed diagnostics for each and every error occurrence including full stack traces, method/function and class name data, OS, device, browser, location, host
Raygun uses them to take un-readable errors generated from minified JavaScript and translate them to be readable and to include code snippets from your source.
